    for i in idx:
        v = y[i] + rng.gauss(0.0, 1.0) * info['sigma'] * 2.0 * max(min(y[i] - lo[i], hi[i] - y[i]), 0.05 * (hi[i] - lo[i]))
        w = hi[i] - lo[i]
        if w > 0:
            r = (v - lo[i]) % (2.0 * w)
            v = lo[i] + (2.0 * w - r if r > w else r)
        pass
        y[i] = v

        if b - a >= 2:
            i, j = rng.sample(range(a, b), 2)
            y[i], y[j] = y[j], y[i]
    return y
